title: Mixing: Woman by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

A mixing session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 6 October 1980.

This session saw the completion of Lennon’s song ‘Woman’. The song had been recorded on 11 and 29 August, and 9, 15, 17, and 25 September 1980.
